csv_project_name: AE for AE: Catawba Bend Preserve Greenway Trail
csv_scope_of_work: York County is soliciting statements of qualifications from firms experienced in the planning, design, permitting, and construction administration of public multi-use greenway trails and related recreational infrastructure. The selected consultant shall provide all professional services necessary to advance the design and construction of approximately four (4) miles of paved multi-use Greenway Trail within Catawba Bend Preserve. Services may include, but are not limited to, project management, surveying, geotechnical engineering, landscape architecture, civil engineering, environmental permitting, hydraulic and structural analysis, preparation of construction documents, bidding assistance, and construction administration.
